# Daily Dashboard V0.5.3

Weather and Calendar now follow the supplied Apple Weather references: indigo backgrounds, translucent rounded surfaces, lighter typography, pale blue controls, and restrained colour in the data graphics.

## Weather

- Feels-like, UV, precipitation and sunrise cards with a UV spectrum, rain-probability bar and sunrise graphic.
- An hourly chart available at every widget size, plus a five-day list with temperature-range bars.
- Softer radar map controls, a precipitation-intensity legend, pause/play, and a frame timeline. Map and weather attribution sit in a dedicated footer.
- A fixed toolbar and an inner scroll area keep all measurements and controls accessible in compact widgets.

## Calendar

- Matching indigo glass surface, rounded category-tinted events, lighter date text, circular current-day highlighting, and pill-shaped controls.
- Saved Work mode remains Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM. Events retain separate collision-safe subcolumns and fitted working hours at every size.

## Verification

The browser suite covers all six enabled widgets at four documented sizes across 19 display/scaling configurations (456 base cases), plus calendar Work mode, weather tiles, hourly and five-day graphics, rain history, radar controls, loading and setup. Production build, unit tests and Rust settings tests are also checked.

Close Daily Dashboard before running the Windows installer over your existing version. The application identifier and settings location are unchanged. Installation over an existing Windows version still needs to be verified on your machine.
